title: Novel antioxidant peptides targeting the Keap1-Nrf2 pathway discovered from Ginkgo biloba seeds protein hydrolysate: Combining virtual screening, quantum chemical calculation, and zebrafish models in vivo validation.
authors: Yao, Mengru; Zhang, Yuhao; Yang, Caijing; Li, Tong; Liu, Haiyi; Zhao, Yiyun; Memtimin, Metsawur; Guo, Sheng; Duan, Jin-Ao; Xiao, Ping
one_liner_zh: 该文研究银杏蛋白水解物中抗氧化肽靶向Keap1-Nrf2通路，虽涉及分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作（Keap1-Nrf2）而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: The development of safe, edible, and highly stable food-derived natural antioxidant peptides holds significant practical value for functional foods and dietary health management. Ginkgo biloba seeds (GBS), as a food resource rich in protein, are an ideal raw material for the preparation of food-grade antioxidant peptides. This study uses papain to hydrolyze Ginkgo biloba seeds protein (GBSP). Two novel peptides (LTGMAFR and IGINGFGR, LR-7 and IR-8) were first identified via peptidomics combined with computational approaches. Molecular docking revealed that the selected peptides all exhibit strong binding affinity to Keap1 (-7.8 to -8.2 kcal/mol), surpassing the positive ligand (9-mer Nrf2, -7.2 kcal/mol). Molecular dynamics simulations validated the complex's dynamic stability. Molecular orbital calculations and Fukui function analysis confirm that these two peptides exhibit excellent electron-donating properties. Furthermore, IR-8 exhibits stronger DPPH and ABTS scavenging activities than LR-7. In an H(2)O(2)-induced oxidative stress model in zebrafish, the target peptides reduced ROS and MDA levels in zebrafish larvae, upregulated antioxidant enzyme levels and the mRNA levels of genes downstream of the Nrf2 pathway, and effectively alleviated H(2)O(2)-induced oxidative damage. Western blot results further confirmed that H(2)O(2)-induced oxidative stress reduces nuclear Nrf2 protein levels and the Nrf2 nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, while peptide intervention effectively restores Nrf2 nuclear accumulation. The Nrf2-specific inhibitor ML385 experiments further confirmed that the antioxidant activity of the target peptides depends on the activation of the Nrf2 pathway. This work elucidates the antioxidant mechanism of GBSP targeting the Keap1-Nrf2 pathway and provides an efficient multi-method strategy for natural antioxidant screening.
abstract_zh: 开发安全、可食用且高度稳定的食源性天然抗氧化肽，对功能性食品和膳食健康管理具有重要的实际价值。银杏种子（GBS）作为一种富含蛋白质的食品资源，是制备食品级抗氧化肽的理想原料。本研究使用木瓜蛋白酶水解银杏种子蛋白（GBSP）。通过肽组学结合计算方法，首次鉴定出两种新型肽（LTGMAFR和IGINGFGR，即LR-7和IR-8）。分子对接显示，所选肽均与Keap1表现出强结合亲和力（-7.8至-8.2 kcal/mol），超过阳性配体（9-mer Nrf2，-7.2 kcal/mol）。分子动力学模拟验证了复合物的动态稳定性。分子轨道计算和Fukui函数分析确认，这两种肽具有优异的供电子特性。此外，IR-8比LR-7表现出更强的DPPH和ABTS清除活性。在斑马鱼的H(2)O(2)诱导氧化应激模型中，目标肽降低了斑马鱼幼鱼体内的ROS和MDA水平，上调了抗氧化酶水平和Nrf2通路下游基因的mRNA水平，并有效缓解了H(2)O(2)诱导的氧化损伤。Western blot结果进一步证实，H(2)O(2)诱导的氧化应激降低了核内Nrf2蛋白水平和Nrf2核质比，而肽干预有效恢复了Nrf2核积累。Nrf2特异性抑制剂ML385实验进一步证实，目标肽的抗氧化活性依赖于Nrf2通路的激活。本研究阐明了GBSP靶向Keap1-Nrf2通路的抗氧化机制，并为天然抗氧化剂筛选提供了一种高效的多方法策略。
